Join Connected Cars on our mission to connect millions of car owners with their vehicles by tapping into the on-board diagnostics available in every modern car.

About Connected Cars

Connected Cars is on a mission to transform how automotive manufacturers and distributors interact with their customers by turning vehicle data into loyal, lasting relationships. By 2030, our vision is to turn vehicle data into timely, personal moments that build trust and drive loyalty, while streamlining operations and boosting efficiency across the value chain.

Our team consists of around 70 people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, brought together by a shared belief in team effort, community, and delivering quality products and solutions.

The Position

We are currently using Node.js (mainly TypeScript), Kubernetes, MySQL, and BigQuery on the backend, hosted on Google Cloud Platform. Having scaled our backend to a global presence, we rely heavily on Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. We believe in releasing early and often, supported by an automated CI/CD pipeline running multiple daily deployments.

Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams of 3–4 people with minimal overhead and bureaucracy. We empower our teams with full decision-making power over how they work, what they focus on, and how they deliver functionality.

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will architect and build robust APIs, backend services, and databases, while taking full ownership of your code from development to production monitoring (via Grafana and Google Cloud Monitoring). You will collaborate closely with other internal engineering teams and periodically communicate with external stakeholders to align on technical integrations and requirements.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a skilled, autonomous engineer with 5+ years of professional backend experience who possesses an inquisitive mind and thrives on taking full ownership of complex problems. You are driven, enthusiastic about software engineering, and proactive in figuring out what needs to be built. Beyond technical execution, you enjoy working cross-functionally and act as a supportive mentor within your team to help colleagues find effective solutions.

Key qualifications and experience:

• 5+ years of experience as a backend engineer building scalable systems.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and building RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and managing large datasets (terabytes in BigQuery or similar).

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and effectively communicate with external stakeholders.

• High degree of autonomy, problem-solving drive, and a natural curiosity to explore new technical solutions.

• Passion for high-quality code, TDD, CI/CD, and mentorship.

Our team is made up of people who genuinely enjoy the process of building things. If you have a GitHub account, a side project, or open-source experience, we’d love to hear about it.

Why Connected Cars

• A collaborative, innovative work environment that encourages growth, ownership, and technical autonomy.

• Competitive salary package and an attractive pension scheme.

• Friday bars, monthly social events, an affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited snacks in the office.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Please send your application through LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. It is not necessary to provide a cover letter, but feel free to if there is extra information you think we should know.

Picture your typical week: on Monday you’re on-site at a client, driving a project team through a critical phase of an IT/OT implementation. By Wednesday you’re facilitating a workshop across business, IT, and engineering to resolve a key delivery issue. Friday, you’re back at Emendo’s Nordhavn office sharing what you learned and sharpening the methods your colleagues will use on their projects. If that sounds like work you’d love, keep reading.

Why We’re Hiring Now

We paused hiring over the past year to be deliberate about the team we build next. The consulting market in Denmark has tightened, and our clients have changed how they buy: they want consultants who can take real ownership, navigate complexity, and show measurable progress quickly. We are now making a small number of hires — each one matters, and we are taking the time to find the right people.

About Emendo

Emendo is a 200-person consultancy built by people who used to sit on the client side — running transformation programmes inside leading global companies before deciding to do it for a living. We understand the pressure a site director feels before a go-live, we know what an inspector looks for in a regulated environment, and we speak the language of the people who operate the systems we implement. We work across the full Operational value chain from R&D through shipping, with offices in Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Odense, Silkeborg, Munich, and Raleigh (USA). Our strategy is simple: deliver faster, prove value in hard numbers, and use our methods and AI tools to do what we do well — only quicker.

We are a methods-driven firm rooted in operational excellence and Lean. Our motto, Observe, Think, Improve, is itself a method: go to the floor, understand what is actually happening, analyse it rigorously, then design and implement a concrete improvement. That simplicity is what makes it reliable when the project gets complicated and the usual playbooks stop working.

The Role

You will lead projects and workstreams within IT/OT transformation engagements for our clients, mainly in (but not limited to) pharma and regulated industries— operating at the intersection of technology, business process, and organisational change. You are expected to create structure, drive progress, coordinate stakeholders, and make sure decisions turn into action. At Emendo, being a Lead Consultant means taking real ownership while continuing to build the judgement and client credibility required to lead increasingly complex engagements.

What You Will Do

• Lead projects and workstreams on-site, driving IT/OT implementations across enterprise, operations management, process control, and process equipment layers

• Create structure and momentum through clear planning, governance, stakeholder alignment, and follow-up

• Drive measurable progress in short cycles — turning project activity into tangible outcomes

• Coordinate cross-functional teams across business, IT, engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders

• Facilitate workshops, resolve issues, manage dependencies, and turn complex discussions into clear decisions and actions

• Engage with solution architecture, validation concepts, and implementation planning within complex project environments

• Build strong client relationships and become a trusted counterpart who takes ownership and gets things done

• Apply Observe, Think, Improve as your foundation and contribute to strengthening Emendo’s methods and tools

What It Takes

Must-Have Qualifications

• Master’s degree in engineering, IT, business, innovation, or a related discipline

• 2–5+ years of hands-on experience delivering IT/OT projects, digital transformations, or technology implementations — ideally within pharma or another regulated industry

• Experience taking ownership of a project, workstream, or significant delivery area

• Strong project management fundamentals, including planning, governance, risk and issue management, and stakeholder coordination

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to create structure in complex or changing environments

• Confidence working across business and technical stakeholders

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Danish skills are strongly preferred, or a commitment to learn

• Willingness to work on-site at client locations in Denmark and occasionally internationally

Nice to have — but not required

None of the following are dealbreakers. If you tick even one or two, it tells us you will ramp up faster — but we have seen great consultants arrive without any of them and build the expertise here.

• Experience with GxP compliance, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), or regulatory frameworks in life sciences

• Familiarity with enterprise systems such as ERP or MES, process control, automation, or IT–OT integration

• Background in operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies

• Experience working across multiple sites or geographies in larger transformation programmes

• Familiarity with AI or automation tools applied to project delivery or enterprise transformation

What Makes Emendo Different

• Measured on outcomes, not utilisation — you work directly with industry leaders on engagements that matter

• Real responsibility early — with experienced colleagues around you when the challenge requires it

• One integrated firm with deep methods: cross-unit collaboration across Implementation, Engineering, Digital, and R&D, backed by a Lean toolbox and AI accelerators

• Freedom under responsibility — challenging projects with room to shape the solution and your own career

• A flat culture where your input matters and your wins are celebrated

• Competitive compensation reflecting the responsibility and impact expected in this role

This role is probably not for you if:

• You prefer purely advisory work with limited implementation responsibility.

• You work best with narrow ownership and very clear boundaries.

• You have strong technical exposure but limited experience driving cross-functional delivery.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We are hiring a small number of Lead Consultants this year. You will join a team that has led some of the largest IT/OT programmes in US and European companies — people who chose Emendo because they wanted meaningful responsibility in a firm that still feels personal. If that resonates, we’d like to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We will be in touch promptly.

For further information, reach out to Mikael Elley (me@emendo.com or +45 24 83 62 01).

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Experimental Parasitology at Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and dynamic postdoc for a 1 year and 6 months position to commence 1 March 2027 or after agreement.

The postdoc will be part of the Parasites, Immunology and Gut Health (PIGH) group in the Section for Parasitology and Pathology.

A list of the group’s publications can be found at:

https://scholar.google.dk/citations?hl=en&user=70v-4RoAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate

Information on the department can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk 

Our group and research
The PIGH group is interested in how dietary components and the gut microbiota interact to regulate type-2 immunity at mucosal surfaces, which is critical for protection against helminth parasites but can also cause pathologies such as allergies when dysregulated. We apply small (rodent) and large (swine) animal models and in vitro cell culture techniques to explore host-pathogen-microbiome interactions and nutritional immunology. The group is a multidisciplinary team embedded within the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, with close links to other sections working on diseases, food chemistry, natural product chemistry, and the gut microbiome. Our aims are to develop novel therapies to prevent infection and disease in animals and humans. The group is international in nature, and the daily working language is English.

Your job 

In this position, you will work on a project exploring interactions between helminths and the host gut microbiome. We are particularly interested in how diet-driven changes in the host gut microbiome impact the parasite infectivity and host resistance. The main role of the postdoc will be to carry out research involving dietary manipulations and experimental parasite infections in laboratory animals. This will be coupled with extensive microbiome analyses including both amplicon-based sequencing approaches and shotgun (metagenomic) approaches and associated bioinformatic analyses. Furthermore, the duties of the Postdoc will include supporting the overall research goals of the group and contributing to a positive and supportive group environment that emphasizes teamwork, curiosity and positivity.

The postdoc’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

• 
research, including publication/academic dissemination duties

• 
research-based teaching

• 
sharing knowledge with society

 Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

Essential experience and skills:

• 
You have a PhD in parasitology, biology or related field

• 
You are experienced in laboratory animal models, including experimental parasite infections, with FELASA accreditation or equivalent.

• 
You have experience in gut microbiome analytical techniques

• 
Demonstrated record of peer-reviewed publications.

• 
Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams.

• 
Excellent English skills written and spoken.

 Desirable experience and skills:

• 
Experience with transcriptomics and immunology techniques (e.g. flow cytometry).

• 
You have an active interest in nutrition and/or gut health.

Place of employment

The place of employment is at the Section for Parasitology and Pathology, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and animal facilities.

Terms of employment 

The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 1 year and 6 months. The start date is 1 March 2027 or after agreement.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW

Questions
For further information please contact Professor Andrew Williams arw@sund.ku.dk 

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

• 
Motivated letter of application (Max. one page)

• 
CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

• 
A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do

• 
List of publications

Deadline for applications: 6 December 2026, 23.59pm CET 

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process 
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

Interviews are expected to be held in week 2, 2027

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Electrical Engineering: Novel NMR Instrumentation for Groundwater Measurements
jobs.description:
Do you want to help develop novel instrumentation for groundwater investigations? At the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Aarhus University, we are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to contribute to the development of novel nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) instruments for groundwater characterization. You will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning electrical engineering, geophysics, and environmental science working on technologies that can improve our understanding of vital groundwater resources. The 2-year position is based in Aarhus, Denmark and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2–year position from 1 March 2027 or as soon possible thereafter.

Job description

We are seeking a postdoctoral researcher in electrical engineering to help develop a new generation of surface NMR instruments for groundwater characterization. Through a recently funded research project, we are building a new instrument with capabilities beyond those of existing systems. As part of the project, you will play a central role in designing and integrating key electronic subsystems and in exploring how the resulting instrument can open new possibilities for groundwater investigations.

Your tasks will include

• Design, simulation, construction, and validation of electronic subsystems

• Interfacing of ADCs and DACs to analog frontends and a microcontroller

• Integration of subsystems into a complete instrument

• Experimental work, including testing of instruments and data collection in both laboratory and field environments

• Data analysis

• Co-supervision of bachelor and master thesis projects within the project

• Documentation of technical development and research results

• Leading and contributing to scientific publications

You will join a collaborative and interdisciplinary team where you will be working closely with other researchers, technicians, and students at the Department. The project also involves interaction with researchers and end-users working directly with groundwater characterization.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in electrical engineering or similar.

Prior experience with surface NMR or groundwater measurements is not required, but we expect you to a have a curiosity for these areas.

We are looking for candidates with experience in several of the following areas:

• Electronic systems design

• Development of low-noise analog and digital electronics including power supplies

• Interfacing to/from ADCs and DACs

• PCB layout

• Solving EMC issues

• Practical electronic and laboratory skills

• Data analysis

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

• Real-time data acquisition systems implemented on microcontrollers

• Embedded Linux

• Power electronics

• Signal processing and embedded signal processing

It is also advantageous if you have a driver’s license.

Personal skills

You have good English skills, both in speaking and in writing. You take responsibility for assigned tasks and communicate openly about progress, challenges, and ideas. You can work independently as well as in a team. You are open-minded, curious, and have a good sense of humour. We value the ability to work independently as well as in a team.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. If you believe you are a strong match for the position but do not meet every listed qualification, we would still like to hear from you.

Who we are

The Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) at Aarhus University is a leading research institution committed to excellence in research, education, and innovation. The department hosts research spanning electronics, signal processing, embedded systems, sensing technologies, artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, digital twins, power electronics, and many other areas, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration and knowledge exchange.

This position will be supervised by Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, whose current research focuses on surface NMR instrumentation, methodology, and applications.

What we offer

We offer a vibrant and inclusive research environment with a clear commitment to real-world impact. This position provides a rare opportunity to help shape the development of an entirely new scientific instrument, from subsystem design and implementation to system integration, testing, and scientific application. You will have substantial technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and the future research capabilities of the instrument. Denmark is consistently ranked among the best countries in the world for work-life balance and quality of life. Family-friendly policies include generous parental leave, subsidised childcare, and access to excellent public healthcare and education. As a postdoc at Aarhus University, you will benefit from a supportive and flexible workplace culture that values diversity and offers excellent conditions for researchers and their families.

Specifically, we offer:

• A central role in the development of a new surface NMR instrument with unique capabilities for groundwater characterization;

• Opportunities to work across the full development chain, from electronics design and system integration to field deployment and scientific application;

• Access to state-of-the-art laboratory facilities and research infrastructure;

• Strong support for research career development, including mentoring and international networking opportunities;

• A workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Finlandsgade 22, 8200 Aarhus N, Denmark, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Contact information

For further information, please contact: Associate Professor Jakob Juul Larsen, + 45 4189 3273, jjl@ece.au.dk_._

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than 4 January 2027.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

_**Do you want to help shape the digital applications that support digital manufacturing at VELUX? As our new Technical Product Owner, you will connect manufacturing needs with solutions enabled by our top-tier Industrial IoT platform, turning business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery-ready work—and helping drive our digitization journey.

**_**Meet your future team

**You will join our growing Industrial IoT Platform Team within the IT & Digital Enablement (IT&DE) department. We work closely with the Operations & Supply (O&S) organization to support the entire VELUX Group globally.

This role is a new addition to the team, and you will work alongside the Senior Technical Product Owner who is accountable for ensuring a common approach. You will connect IT and Supply and own an assigned area of manufacturing applications and capabilities within that framework. Your scope can evolve as portfolio priorities and the product model develop, contributing to VELUX’s continuous digitization journey.

**What We Offer

**As Technical Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to shape your part of an evolving digital manufacturing application landscape. You will own the technical product direction, roadmap, backlog and day-to-day decisions, in close collaboration with the business, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, scalable and sustainable product path.

You will connect manufacturing needs with delivery-ready work for technical teams, helping establish a consistent product mindset across your scope. To make that work clear and actionable, you will establish and maintain product requirements, processes and guardrails that support development and delivery.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Own and continuously develop the technical product roadmap and backlog for your agreed area of digital manufacturing applications and capabilities.

• Turn incoming business needs into clearly defined problems and desired outcomes, then shape them into features with acceptance criteria. Keep the backlog structured and sufficiently refined for delivery teams to begin work, meeting the agreed Definition of Ready standards.

• Manage the technical capability lifecycle from prioritised business need and validation through delivery, operational feedback and continuous improvement, using agreed measures to inform product-quality and lifecycle decisions.

You can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. The role requires regular physical presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark, with occasional travel abroad. When tasks and projects allow, you can work from home up to 2 days per week.

**What You Will Bring Into The Organization

**You bring experience from product ownership, product management or a comparable business-facing role within digital manufacturing, including evolving or multi-product scopes.

You can collaborate with both business and technical colleagues to turn priorities into delivery-ready work, and you are ready to bring structure, accountability and product focus to a development organisation.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, including how operational applications, enterprise systems, machine integration and data interact. Broader knowledge of digital manufacturing landscapes is an advantage.

• Can create product roadmaps, structure complex demand, and translate desired outcomes into delivery-ready features and backlogs.

• Take a disciplined, outcome-oriented approach to product ownership, establishing and maintaining clear product requirements, processes and decision guardrails. Balance standardization and short-term delivery needs with long-term product integrity.

• Have experience working in a complex matrix organisation, using stakeholder collaboration, clear communication and sound decision-making to align colleagues across organisational boundaries.

• Have the technical fluency to collaborate credibly with architects, technical leads and engineering teams.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**In This Role, You’ll

**

**AI at Chainalysis

As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

**About Chainalysis

**Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

**You belong here.

**At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

We are looking for a QA Manager who ensures that suppliers fulfill their quality responsibilities, drives operational excellence at our suppliers and secures a reliable product supply. You are proactive, analytical, and capable of leading quality initiatives across internal teams and supplier sites, while having a Supply Chain understanding.

This position is responsible for Supplier quality management, without direct line management responsibilities.

About the job

As QA Manager, you will be a key member of a cross-functional Supplier Relationship Team (SRT), responsible for:

• Ensuring suppliers comply with quality technical agreements

• Collaborating and connecting Quality and Supply Chain, ensuring that quality matters with impact on supply are in focus.

• Leading and tracking quality matters such as OOS, OOT, complaints, major deviations, and change controls, including root cause investigations and mitigation plans.

• Collaborating with internal teams and suppliers for technical transfers, new product introductions, and insourcing transfers to ensure compliant product launch and stable supply.

• Defining quality KPI targets with Supplier Relationship Managers (SRMs), monitoring supplier performance, and driving improvement plans where needed.

• Take active part in business review meetings with suppliers, responsible for bringing the supplier quality performance evaluation on the agenda. Acting as primary point-of-contact for all quality matters not handled in daily operations, promoting communication and collaboration with internal functions and suppliers.

• This role will not be writing deviations, creating change controls, performing audits etc., but supporting the teams doing these tasks when needed.

You will report to the Department Manager Supplier Management with a dotted line to the Supplier Relationship Director.

Who are you?

You have experience in quality management, supplier oversight, and operational excellence.

We expect you to have experience in quality operations e.g. managing audits, deviations, complaints, product release and quality oversight processes and have strong collaboration and communication skills for working across departments and with supplier counterparts.

A strong commercial mindset and strategic relationship building, grounded in quality and compliance, are the key to ensuring timely deliveries and a stable, resilient product supply. You have a general understanding of Supply chain, and are capable of connecting supply chain and quality.

Lastly you have a proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives and thrive working with data and are curious about AI.

Who are we?

You will work closely with the SRT and internal functions, supporting quality oversight and ensuring reliable product supply. The team focuses on collaboration, transparency, and improvement across supplier operations and internal processes.

Job Location

Warsaw, Poland or Odense, Denmark.

Hybrid work model – 3x/week from the office.
